meta.title: 视觉传达基础：点线面与构图
meta.title_en: Basics of Visual Communication: Dots, Lines, Planes, and Composition

scenes.context: 讲者用显示器白屏演示：纯白屏幕没有落点，出现一个黑点视觉才有落脚点；黑点移动视觉跟着移动，黑点足够多就形成一条线。
sentences: 屏幕上一片纯白，你的视觉不知道看哪里。
A pure white screen leaves your eyes nowhere to rest.
不知道看哪里：nowhere to rest
当屏幕上出现一个黑点，你的视觉就有了落脚点。
A black dot gives your vision an anchor.
落脚点：an anchor
黑点足够多，就形成了一条线，视觉会被线条锁定。
Enough dots form a line, and your eye is locked onto it.
被线条锁定：locked onto the line
paraphrase: 纯白屏幕 → 视觉无落点
Blank space gives the eye nowhere to land.
黑点移动 → 形成线条
Moving dots trace lines the eye follows.
scenes.speak: A pure white screen leaves your eyes nowhere to rest. A black dot gives your vision an anchor. Enough dots form a line, and your eye is locked onto it.

scenes.title_en: Lines build planes, planes build objects
scenes.context: 讲者继续：线条足够多组成面，很多面组成物体，视觉在物体的线条上游走——点线面可以是公路、建筑、小河、大树等现实物体。
sentences: 当线条足够多，可以组成一个面。
When lines multiply, they form a plane.
组成一个面：form a plane
很多个面又可以组成某个物体。
Many planes come together into an object.
组成物体：come together into an object
点线面可以是现实中的任何物体，比如公路、建筑、小河、大树。
Dots, lines, and planes can be anything real — a road, a building, a river, a tree.
任何物体：anything real
paraphrase: 线多成面 → 面多成物
Lines stack into planes, planes into objects.
现实物体 → 都是线条元素
Real scenes are just lines that guide the eye.
scenes.speak: When lines multiply, they form a plane. Many planes come together into an object. Dots, lines, and planes can be anything real — a road, a building, a river, a tree.

scenes.context: 讲者总结：视觉有心理重量，画面会左中右倾，放一个物体能找回平衡；构图最重要的是结构——抓取画面结构的配重比例，用最少元素交代最全面的现实。
sentences: 视觉是有心理重量的，画面会左中右倾。
Vision carries psychological weight, so a frame can tip left or right.
心理重量：psychological weight
在右边放置一个物体，就会找回视觉的平衡。
Placing an object on the right restores the visual balance.
找回平衡：restore the balance
构图最重要的是结构，用最少的元素交代最全面的现实。
Composition is all about structure — saying the most with the least.
最少的元素：the fewest elements
paraphrase: 视觉有重量 → 画面会倾斜
Visual weight tilts an unbalanced frame.
构图 = 结构配重 → 最少交代最多
Composition balances structure to say more with less.
scenes.speak: Vision carries psychological weight, so a frame can tip left or right. Placing an object on the right restores the visual balance. Composition is all about structure — saying the most with the least.

practice: A black dot gives your vision an anchor.
Enough dots form a line the eye follows.
Placing an object restores the visual balance.
Good composition says the most with the least.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Your eye doesn't know where to see.
✓ 地道说法：Your eyes have nowhere to rest.
视觉无落点用 nowhere to rest。
✕ 直译腔：Dots make a line when they are much.
✓ 地道说法：Enough dots form a line.
用 enough 表达「足够多」。
✓ 地道说法：The frame carries psychological weight.
✕ 直译腔：The composition's structure is the most important.
✓ 地道说法：Composition is all about structure.
shifts: 注意引导视觉的线条结构
用最少元素交代最全面的现实
